title: Embedding a field-loader configuration
statement: Let $l$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a binary input word, and let $p$ be an input-head position for $x$. Choose a field index $i<l$, a loader control $q$, old words for all fields, a stream, a replacement word, and an integer cursor position $s$. Embed the two-tape configuration whose tapes contain the stream and replacement word into the row loader’s slots for field $i$ and the stream, using the row loader’s current tape contents for the other slots and placing their heads at zero. The resulting configuration is the row-loader configuration with field $i$ replaced by the replacement word, all other fields unchanged, and the stream and cursor preserved.
hypotheses_covered: old assigns a binary word to each of the $l$ fields
replaced: For every input word, input position, target field $i$, loader control, old field words, stream, replacement word, and cursor, relocating the two-tape loader configuration into the row loader's slots, retaining all other fields, yields the row seam in which only field $i$ has been replaced; every other field remains untouched.
